description: This file contains unit tests for SSL server socket implementation, including classes FakeSocket and FakeDataChannel for simulating socket data exchange, and tests for handshake, session caching, client certificates, ALPS, and data transfer behaviors.

classes.name: MockCTPolicyEnforcer
classes.description: Mock implementation of CTPolicyEnforcer that always returns compliance.

classes.name: FakeDataChannel
classes.description: Simulates data exchange between sockets for testing purposes.

classes.name: FakeSocket
classes.description: Simulates a network socket using FakeDataChannel instances.

methods.name: FakeDataChannel::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the fake channel, possibly asynchronously.

methods.name: FakeDataChannel::Write
methods.description: Writes data to the fake channel, possibly asynchronously.

methods.name: FakeDataChannel::Close
methods.description: Closes the fake data channel, causing subsequent reads to return EOF.

methods.name: FakeSocket::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the fake socket.

methods.name: FakeSocket::Write
methods.description: Writes data to the fake socket.
